About Orchestra Group

Our Mission is Reducing Cyber Risk

Small and medium sized enterprises, non- profits and local governments are the most frequent targets of cyber-attack. Lacking the budgets and specialized staff of large enterprises, SMEs have become the preferred “soft targets” of cyber criminals.

Orchestra Group is on a mission to protect SMEs from cyber-attacks. Our advanced, automated cybersecurity solutions proactively identify the most significant risks and exposures and provide clear, easy to follow guidance on how to eliminate them.

Our breakthrough innovations bring advanced cyber defenses to small and medium enterprises.

Smartscan Network Discovery

Our patented, agentless lightweight scanning technology discovers servers, network gear, applications, configurations, security controls and vulnerabilities.

Digital Cyber Twin

Harmony Purple builds a virtual replica of your IT estate, including all the information attackers use to penetrate your defenses. The Digital Cyber Twin provides a platform for holistic, non-invasive attack simulation.

AI Driven Attack Path Scenarios

Our unique AI reasoning engine reveals the often-hidden weaknesses in your security controls. Harmony Purple runs millions of attack path simulations using the same methods and techniques attackers use.

Benefits

  • Automated
  • System wide “attackers eye view” of the network
  • Holistic, actionable risk reduction recommendations
  • Integrated cyber risk policy and compliance reporting
  • Simple to deploy and use
  • All-in-One

Open Opportunities

at Orchestra Group

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Central Europe
Role Description

About Orchestra Group:

Orchestra Group is a dynamic and innovative Cybersecurity company specializing in Automated Continuous Threat Exposure Management solutions. We’re on a mission to revolutionize the way MSP and MSSPs are serving their SMBs customers and the way SMB companies address their cybersecurity risk and exposure.

 

Job Description:

Orchestra Group is seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our expanding team working to grow the company footprint in the Central Europe region. As an SDR, you will play a critical role in generating leads and driving our sales pipeline. You will work closely with the sales and marketing teams to identify and qualify potential customers, ensuring a steady flow of opportunities for our sales professionals..

Responsibilities will include:
  1. Prospecting and Lead Generation: Identify and research potential customers in the Central Europe region, leveraging various tools and techniques to build a robust prospect list.
  2. Outreach and Engagement: Initiate contact with prospects through phone calls, emails, and social media to create interest in Orchestra Group’s products/services.
  3. Qualification: Qualify leads by understanding their needs, challenges, and budget constraints to determine their suitability as potential customers.
  4. Product Knowledge: Develop a deep understanding of Orchestra Group’s products/services and effectively communicate their value propositions to prospects.
  5. Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of all interactions with prospects in our CRM system, ensuring smooth handovers to the sales team.
  6. Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the marketing team to align on lead generation strategies and messaging.
  7. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on industry trends and competitive offerings to provide valuable insights during prospect interactions.
Qualifications
  • Proven experience in sales development, lead generation, or a related role.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Fluency in English (mother tongue level) is a must and Spanish is major advantage, other European languages is advantage.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Self-motivated and target-driven mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely.
  • Knowledge of CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) is a plus.
Why Join Orchestra Group
  • Opportunity for Growth: Be part of a growing organization with ample opportunities for career advancement.
  • Innovative Environment: Work in a dynamic and creative environment that encourages new ideas and innovation.
  • Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work with occasional team meetings and collaboration.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Training and Development: Access ongoing training and development to enhance your skills and career prospects.

 

If you’re excited about joining a forward-thinking company that values teamwork, innovation, and personal growth, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today to join Orchestra Group as an SDR in Central Europe and help shape the future of our business.

Note: This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the position and is not an exhaustive list of skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities, or working conditions associated with it. Orchestra Group is an equal opportunity employer.

DevOps team lead

Tel Aviv
Role Description

We are Orchestra Group – an exciting, well-funded start-up led by a team of experienced entrepreneurs. Orchestra is a platform for seamless security management and operations providing a single security truth from “Board to Bits”. Orchestra’s policy-as-code links cyber security, risk, compliance and threat management into a single integrated platform. Orchestra’s vision is to become the leading platform for cyber security management and operations worldwide. Our target markets are US and Europe, especially Fortune 5000 enterprises.

We use leading edge technologies such as graph databases, NoSQL and deep insight algorithms to create a unique platform for cyber security. We are located in the heart of Tel Aviv.

We are looking for a Hands-on DevOps Team Lead to Work with various departments (including R&D, sales and operations) of the Orchestra group to increase productivity in the workplace and in production operations. This will bring about a need to create and to develop systems within a company, integrate and implement software systems also to analyze metrics and system to improve existing tools.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leading our DevOps team of 3-5 engineers

  • Work with cutting edge tools both on-premise and in heterogeneous cloud environments 

  • Maintain automatization of development, integration and delivery processes for our cloud and on-premise environments

Relevant Technologies: Cloud providers; GCP, AWS, OCI, Docker Containers, Kubernetes, VMware VSphere, Jenkins, Linux (Sys Admin), Windows, DNS, Network Segmentation (LAN, vLAN, VPN) Grafana, Splunk, Mongo, Kafka, Zookeeper, Storm, MongoDB, MySQL, Time-Series DB (Grafite or InfluxDB), HDFS, Yarn

 
Relevant Programming languages: Python, Java, SH Scripting
Qualifications:

  • 3-5 Years as DevOps engineer

  • working with large teams and multiple environment

  • Scripting capabilities 

  • Have experience with at least 5 relevant technologies from the above list

Personal Skills:
  • Team Player
  • Good time and task management skills
  • Analytic skills, wide system vision + troubleshooting
  • Excellent English and Hebrew
  • Communication skills (interpersonal and organizational aspects)
  • Understanding business needs and customer demands
  • High self learning skills

Solution Engineer

Tel Aviv
Role Description

Orchestra group, is an Israeli -American, exciting, well-funded cybersecurity start-up led by a team of experienced entrepreneurs in a fast growth stage.

 

Orchestra Group’s mission is to address the major roadblocks that make it difficult for CISO, CIO, and their teams to manage cybersecurity such as:

  1. Fragmented technologies using different paradigms for each slice of the cybersecurity puzzle leading to a cyber stack of between 25 to120 different technologies in every large organization.
  2. Lack of standard metrics to measure, manage, and benchmark cyber defense. This is crucial to drive efficiency, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of organizations’ security.
  3. Constant change is now the norm for business and IT. Cybersecurity requires constant tuning of the trade-offs between shifting IT\Business needs and cyber risk.

 

 

We are currently recruiting a few Solution Engineers (SE) to drive our sales efforts and growth in LATAM, APAC and EMEA.

 

We are looking for a Solution Engineer (SE) for our two security product lines.

Harmony IoT is the market leader in Wireless Airspace cyber security, with customers worldwide that creates a protection airspace dome around organizations to monitor, detect threats and mitigate cyberattacks through the attack surface of WiFi and Bluetooth protocols as well as smart-connected devices and IoTs.

 

Harmony Purple – a next-generation Automated Purple team tool that continuously showcases validated, global, multi-vector, Attack Path Scenarios™ (APS) and creates Risk modeling based prioritization, to support red teams and create the most effective and efficient remediation plan for the blue teams to focus their time and resources on those vulnerabilities that threaten the organization’s critical assets and business processes the most. 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • We are looking for a dynamic self-managed and fast learning Solution Engineer (SE) to support PoCs with customers. The SE will need to become expert in Harmony IoT and Harmony Purple capabilities and technologies, able to implement and run proof of concept with customers, answer customer questions and address customer concerns.
    He will need to collaborate with R&D, and Customer Success teams, when needed, to solve PoC and other technical problems.

     

    Harmony IoT includes Raspberry pi hardware sensors installed at the customer site. The sales engineer will need to plan and assist with the on-site deployment process and will need good problem solving skills when issues arise in PoC installations.

    Specific experience and skills for supporting Harmony IoT:

    ·       Good working knowledge of Wifi

    ·       Good working knowledge of Raspberry Pi, including installation and monitoring

    ·       Experience with Linux

    ·       Good understanding of IOT security

    ·       A technical understanding of APIs

    ·       Prior experience in cyber security solutions is a must

     

     

    Harmony Purple is a VM (VMware / Hyper-V) based product that is installed on the customer networks. The customer engineer will need to have a good understanding in complex enterprise networks, to plan and assist in the deployment process, system configuration and results analysis. 

Qualifications:

Specific experience and skills for supporting Harmony Purple:

  • Experience in enterprise software or networking solutions.
  • Experience with VMware or Hyper-V virtualization.
  • Unix/Linux Knowledge (networking/basic commands).
  • Experience working with cloud platforms – AWS/Azure

 

Overall experience and skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as Solution Engineer
  • Hands on knowledge experience with customer installations
  • Very good problem-solving skills when issues arise during PoCs
  • Basic programming\scripting skills a plus
  • A technical understanding of APIs
  • Prior experience in cyber security solutions is a must
  • Experience in manage, deliver, and create detailed responses to products’ RFPs
  • Ability to plan, coordinate and balance multiple projects at the same time
  • Identify and communicate customer requirements to the sales manager, Product teams, and Development teams
  • Experience working with CRM software
  • Strong presentation and demo skills including ability to present at conferences and technical seminars
  • Willingness to travel as required.
  • Good spoken and written English (for LATAM Spanish is Must, Portuguese an advantage)
  • Excellent personal skills
  • Team work spirit self-motivation and positive “can do” attitude
